oriel.disconnect.required: This server requires Oriel UI on the client (protocol %s). Install it and reconnect.
oriel.disconnect.protocol: Oriel UI protocol mismatch. This server requires protocol %s. Install a compatible client version and reconnect.
oriel.demo.title: Oriel demos
oriel.serverPages.typing: This page is from the server. Never type your Microsoft password here.
oriel.serverPages.blocked: Oriel: this server kept reopening pages after you closed them. Its pages are blocked for %s seconds.
oriel.serverPages.ask.title: This server wants to show you a page
oriel.serverPages.ask.message: Pages are made by the server and can look like any screen. Allow pages from this server until you leave?
oriel.effect.minecraft.speed.desc: Movement speed +20% per level; the view widens a little.
oriel.effect.minecraft.slowness.desc: Movement speed -15% per level; the view narrows a little.
oriel.effect.minecraft.haste.desc: Mining and attack speed +10% per level.
oriel.effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.de: Mining slows down sharply; attacks are slower.
oriel.effect.minecraft.regeneration.desc: Restores health over time, faster at higher levels.
oriel.effect.minecraft.water_breathing.d: No air is used up underwater.
oriel.effect.minecraft.invisibility.desc: Your body is invisible and mobs notice you less (armour still shows).
oriel.effect.minecraft.blindness.desc: Darkness closes in; no sprinting or critical hits.
oriel.effect.minecraft.poison.desc: Loses health over time, but never down to zero.
oriel.effect.minecraft.wither.desc: Loses health over time, and can kill.
oriel.effect.minecraft.levitation.desc: Float upwards, whether you like it or not.
oriel.effect.minecraft.slow_falling.desc: Fall slowly and take no fall damage.
oriel.effect.minecraft.conduit_power.des: Underwater breathing, night vision and faster mining underwater.
oriel.effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc: Turns into a raid omen when you enter a village.
oriel.effect.minecraft.raid_omen.desc: A raid is about to start here.
oriel.effect.minecraft.wind_charged.desc: Releases a wind burst on death.
oriel.effect.minecraft.infested.desc: Silverfish may burst out when hurt.
